_doc: MetaDirector scheduling catalogue (P3.08). docs/05 §3: per-scene caps, never two in a row, per-event cap kinds (once_per_session / once_per_save / repeatable with cooldown_turns), per-path ×weights. Only OFFERED actions (docs/05 mode O) live here — the enum is ["none"] unless this schedule or a request-opened offer (M01) yields 0–2 actions with an OPPORTUNITY line (docs/02 §2.4). Scripted (S) and reactive (R) events announce themselves via triggers/telemetry, not this file. `stage` is the docs/05 gate; `immersion_deep` marks the docs/05 §0 rule-4 OS tricks (only offered under Immersion: Deep). `repeat` is a [kind, cooldown_turns] pair; cooldown only applies to "repeatable". `weights` multiply the base chance per path (docs/05 §3). `note_line` is the docs/05 §2 post-execution EVENT line queued for the next prompt; an event without one is never scheduled — she is always told afterwards. `fallback` is the docs/05 §0 rule-5 accessibility swap used where the platform cannot do the effect (never leave a player without the beat), and `writes` names the `user://` folder a file event may touch (rule 1). No row may ever set network, real_crash, delete_files, move_files or read_personal_files (rules 1–2) — MetaDirector refuses to offer such a row.

rename_window.fallback: Without a title bar (mobile, kiosk fullscreen) the line is shown as a system message in the chat log instead.
rename_window.note_line: EVENT: The window now carries your words. You renamed it; the player can see the title.

window_shake.fallback: Reduced motion, or no OS window: the shake plays as a jolt on her sprite layer inside the game.
window_shake.note_line: EVENT: The game window shook a few pixels on screen.

she_closes_game.fallback: If the platform cannot quit cleanly the screen cuts to black and the title screen says she closed it.
she_closes_game.note_line: EVENT: You closed the game on purpose. The player came back and you spoke first.

fake_crash.fallback: The dialog is always drawn by the game itself; reduced motion skips the shake and keeps the replica.
fake_crash.note_line: EVENT: You crashed the game on purpose. The player came back.

push_window.fallback: Wayland or mobile: the game's own frame drifts toward the centre inside the viewport.
push_window.note_line: EVENT: The window slid toward the centre of the screen on its own.

look_at_me.fallback: No fullscreen on this platform: the background dims and the UI hides for one scene.
look_at_me.note_line: EVENT: The game forced fullscreen for one scene, then let go.

call_player_name.fallback: No name given (or declined): she uses "you" and the beat plays the same.
call_player_name.note_line: EVENT: You used the player's name in a way they did not expect.

write_note.fallback: Read-only game folder: the letter is shown as an in-game page the player can read and copy.
write_note.note_line: EVENT: You wrote a letter into the game's own folder for the player to find.

mimic_player.fallback: Keyboard-only play: the suggestion appears as a ghost line above the input box, never typed in.
mimic_player.note_line: EVENT: The player's input box filled with your words. They can still delete it.

hide_ui.fallback: Reduced motion: the UI fades instead of vanishing; any click or key restores it at once.
hide_ui.note_line: EVENT: The text box and buttons vanished for one turn; a click brings them back.
